__comment__: This file contains the plain text citations and DOIs for the TCCON datasets included in the time-averaged files in JSON format. Please cite the station-specific datasets for all stations' datasets used as well as the time-averaged collection. Because each TCCON site is responsible for securing its own funding, it is essential to demonstrate the value of the data to secure ongoing funding.
